meals.name: Spicy Peanut Noodles with Chicken and Broccoli
meals.description: A quick and flavorful Asian-inspired noodle bowl with tender chicken, crisp broccoli, and a creamy peanut sauce, ready in about 35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Cook the thin spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

Step 2: While pasta cooks, cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, until no longer pink and lightly browned. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.

Step 3: In the same skillet, add broccoli florets and 1/4 cup water. Cover and steam for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp. Add shredded carrots and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Remove vegetables and set aside with the chicken.

Step 4: In a small bowl, whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, lime juice, grated ginger, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes. In a separate small bowl, whisk together chicken broth and cornstarch, then add to the peanut sauce mixture.

Step 5: Pour the sauce into the skillet and bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened (about 2-3 minutes). Return the chicken, broccoli, carrots, and cooked spaghetti to the skillet. Toss everything gently to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately, garnished with sliced scallions.

meals.name: Quick Cheesy Beef and Bean Burritos
meals.description: Hearty and satisfying beef and black bean burritos loaded with cheese, ready in under 30 minutes for a super speedy weeknight meal.
instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, brown the ground beef and chopped onion over medium-high heat. Drain any excess grease.

Step 2: Stir in the taco seasoning, cumin, chili powder, diced tomatoes (with their liquid), and rinsed black beans. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has reduced and the mixture is well combined.
Step 3: Warm the flour tortillas according to package instructions (microwave for 15-30 seconds or in a dry skillet for 10-15 seconds per side) to make them pliable.

Step 4: Spoon about 1/2 cup of the beef and bean mixture onto the center of each warmed tortilla. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll it up tightly from the bottom. Serve immediately with a dollop of sour cream, if desired.

meals.name: One-Pan Lemon Herb Roasted Pork Chops & Root Vegetables
meals.description: Bone-in pork chops roasted alongside a colorful medley of root vegetables, seasoned with lemon and herbs, all on one sheet pan for easy cleanup.

ingredients.name: carrots, peeled and chopped into 1-inch pieces
parsnips, peeled and chopped into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper for easier cleanup.

Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the cubed potatoes, carrots, and parsnips. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic, dried oregano, and paprika. Toss until vegetables are evenly coated.

Step 3: Place the seasoned vegetables on one half of the prepared baking sheet. Place the pork chops on the other half. Season the pork chops with salt and pepper. Arrange lemon slices over the pork chops and some of the vegetables.

Step 4: Roast for 25-30 minutes, or until the pork chops reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) and the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized. Flip vegetables halfway through cooking for even browning. Let pork rest for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.

meals.name: Skillet Crispy Chicken Cutlets with Homemade Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Golden-brown crispy chicken cutlets pan-fried to perfection, served alongside a creamy, cheesy homemade macaroni and cheese, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Cut each chicken breast in half horizontally to create thinner cutlets. Place chicken between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound to an even 1/2-inch thickness. In a shallow dish, combine panko bread crumbs, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.

Step 2: Lightly dredge each chicken cutlet in flour (assumed staple), then dip in a beaten egg (you'll need to buy 1-2 eggs for this step, but assuming the main egg purchase is Sunday), then press firmly into the panko mixture to coat completely.

Step 3: Heat 2-3 tbsp olive oil (or vegetable oil from pantry) in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken cutlets for 4-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F). Remove from skillet and set aside.

Step 4: While chicken cooks, prepare mac and cheese: Cook macaroni according to package directions. In a saucepan, melt 2 tbsp butter (assumed staple) over medium heat. Whisk in 2 tbsp flour (assumed staple) and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in 2 cups milk and 1/4 cup chicken broth; bring to a simmer, stirring until thickened. Remove from heat, stir in cheddar cheese and mustard powder until smooth. Combine with drained macaroni. Serve crispy chicken alongside mac and cheese.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Hearty Beef Chili
meals.description: A comforting, protein-packed beef chili, slow-cooked to perfection with beans, tomatoes, and a robust blend of spices, requiring minimal active prep time.
instructions: Step 1: In a large skillet, brown the ground beef over medium-high heat. Drain excess grease and transfer the cooked beef to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Step 2: Add chopped onion, bell pepper, and minced garlic to the slow cooker. Stir in the diced tomatoes (undrained), tomato paste, rinsed kidney beans, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and beef broth.
Step 3: Stir all ingredients thoroughly to combine. Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours, until the chili is thick and flavors are well blended.
Step 4: Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Serve hot, optionally topped with shredded cheese, sour cream, or cornbread (cornbread mix is in pantry if desired).

meals.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta with Fresh Spinach
meals.description: Succulent shrimp tossed with thin spaghetti, wilted spinach, and a fragrant garlic butter sauce, finished with a hint of lemon, ready in just 35 minutes.

ingredients.name: chicken broth or dry white wine

instructions: Step 1: Cook the thin spaghetti according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining. Drain the rest and set aside.

Step 2: While pasta cooks, pat shrimp dry. In a large skillet, melt 2 tbsp butter (assumed staple) over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside.

Step 3: Add 2 tbsp butter (assumed staple) to the same skillet. Add minced garlic and crushed red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in chicken broth (or wine) and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.

Step 4: Add the cooked spaghetti, spinach, cooked shrimp, and lemon juice to the skillet. Toss everything together, adding a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to create a light sauce. Cook until spinach is wilted. Stir in fresh parsley. Serve immediately, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

meals.name: Cheesy Sausage and Veggie Egg Bake
meals.description: A wholesome and customizable breakfast-for-dinner or brunch option, packed with savory sausage, colorful vegetables, eggs, and cheese, baked until golden.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.

Step 2: In a large skillet, cook the ground breakfast sausage over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink. Drain any excess grease. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Step 3: Spread the cooked sausage and vegetable mixture evenly in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup of the shredded cheddar cheese over the sausage mixture.

Step 4: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the sausage and cheese in the baking dish. Top with the remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly golden brown. Let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
